Thanks Elena — great to hear the target date and thanks for the template. Looping in Legal (Laura), Solutions (Karthik), and CS (Naomi) to own the MAP slices.

Quick answers up front:
- DPA: we use a standard DPA with a Data Processing Appendix that enumerates categories of Customer Data and subprocessors. We can provide our standard redline and accept a negotiated retention appendix.
- Archival: we offer configurable archival/retention policies. Typical customers select either a 90-day auto-delete (default for hosted API) or a managed-archival option (longer retention for audit/backups). For regulated use we can support EU-only residency and a per-account archival SLA (we've negotiated 7-year retention for enterprise backups in the past).
- CAIQ + SOC 2: attaching a SOC 2 summary and a CAIQ export link in the MAP doc.

Next steps I propose (short):
1) Redwood provides a MAP draft (owners, milestones) and CAIQ export by EOD tomorrow. (Owner: Marcus)
2) Legal redline window: Laura to propose DPA redline by 2026-06-22. (Owner: Laura)
3) SE (Karthik) to provide environment/residency options and evidence location by 2026-06-23. (Owner: Karthik)
4) CS (Naomi) to coordinate SOC2 evidence review session week of 6/22. (Owner: Naomi)

I attached a short response doc with the items we typically fill in for MAPs and the SOC 2 summary. If that works I'll convert OmniFin's template into our tracker and share the draft MAP.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
